decisions.reason: As a niche men's sub-line with several variants, it uses more shelf and coordination capacity in a firm with a narrow range and no visible evidence of strong traction, so under bounded rationality management would be somewhat more likely to reallocate resources if results were merely below aspiration.

This cleansing foam fits very closely with the firm's established natural skincare range and specifically extends an existing series, so in a growing industry and absent clear signs of underperformance management would more likely continue it.
